in_sanskrit.name: मालव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is from America, a protector of animals or a brave one.

in_hindi.name: मालव
in_hindi.meaning: माला (गाढ़ी) व, अमेरिका के साथ जाने वाला, पशुपति, विक्रमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who wears a garland (mālā) of 'v' letter, one who goes to America, a protector of animals or a brave one.

in_tamil.name: மாலவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who lives on a hill, one who rules a fort or a king of a hill.

in_telugu.name: మాలవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is from a place called Mīdēhōṭṭu, one who is like a Yoddha (warrior) of Indra or a king of a place called Mīdēhōṭṭu.

in_marathi.name: Malav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'malati', which means 'young' or 'tender'. In Hindu mythology, Malav is the name of a king and a hero in various legends.

in_bengali.name: Malav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Young, tender
in_bengali.long_meaning: Malav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'malati', which means 'young' or 'tender'. In Hindu mythology, Malav is the name of a king and a hero in various legends.
